d:
More than three decades after American forces withdrew from Subic Bay in 1992, the strategic port is once again at the centre of US military planning in the Indo-Pacific.
A Chinese think tank alleges that Washington is transforming Subic Bay into an 'unbranded military base' through commercial investments, infrastructure upgrades, fuel storage facilities, ship repair capacity and military deployments.
Meanwhile, a Chinese H-6 bomber reportedly flew within 45 nautical miles of the western coast of Luzon, close to the approaches to Subic Bay.
